AddDocuments.description_en:
Registers files that have been uploaded to the knowledge base storage as knowledge base documents and automatically triggers parsing (chunking and embedding). Supports two types of import:

`LOCAL_UPLOAD`: Used with the `GetKnowledgeBasePreSignedUrl` direct upload process. This operation only registers the files and does not verify whether the files have been actually uploaded. Therefore, you must complete the PUT upload first.
`OSS_IMPORT`: Imports files from an external OSS bucket. This operation creates an asynchronous import task and returns the `knowledge_import_task_id`. The system downloads and registers the files in the background.

A maximum of 100 files can be processed at a time
AddDocuments.description_zh:
把已上传到知识库存储的文件注册为知识库文档并自动触发解析（切片、embedding）。支持两类导入：

`LOCAL_UPLOAD`：配合 `GetKnowledgeBasePreSignedUrl` 直传流程（本接口只注册，不再校验文件是否已真实上传，因此必须先完成 PUT 上传）；
`OSS_IMPORT`：从外部 OSS 导入，接口先创建异步导入任务，返回 `knowledge_import_task_id`，由系统后台执行下载与注册。

单次最多 100 个文件

GetKnowledgeBasePreSignedUrl.description_en: Generates an Object Storage Service (OSS) pre-signed PUT URL pointing to the dedicated storage of the knowledge base for each file in `Documents`. Callers use the URL to upload file content directly to OSS and then call `AddDocuments` to complete the registration. A maximum of 100 files can be processed at a time
GetKnowledgeBasePreSignedUrl.description_zh: 为 `Documents` 中的每个文件生成一个指向知识库专属存储的 OSS 预签名 PUT URL，调用方用该 URL 直接把文件内容上传到对象存储，随后调用 `AddDocuments` 完成注册。单次最多 100 个文件
